groups.problem: The Javadoc of the void require* methods (requireView, requireViewClientScopes) was copy-pasted from the can* methods and says the method 'returns true' instead of saying it throws ForbiddenException.
groups.rationale: Each suggestion reports the same copy-paste Javadoc mistake on the require* methods. S4 and S5 each cover one method and S11 covers both, so one doc fix pass resolves all three.

groups.problem: When the feature is enabled, the ClientRemovedEvent listener calls clients().setPermissionsEnabled, which now resolves to ClientPermissionsV2 and throws UnsupportedOperationException, so client deletion fails.
groups.rationale: All four describe the same failure: the removal listener calls the V2 stub that throws. They point at either the listener or MgmtPermissionsV2.clients(), and one fix resolves it.

problems: Removing a client, role or group with FGAP enabled calls ClientPermissionsV2.setPermissionsEnabled, which throws UnsupportedOperationException.
With FGAP disabled, the cleanup that used to run on removal is now skipped.
uncoveredProblems: With the feature disabled, the V1 cleanup on entity removal no longer runs, which leaves orphaned authorization resources.
